edge.title: Fixed late weight pulses (Trail/BroadDelta) + phase & anchor readouts
edge.summary: Keeps #41's optimizer (incl. Circuit-Muon) unchanged and adds fixed, validation-free late-trajectory weight edits, with the run shortened to 2850 steps (configuration from run.sh; see caveats). BroadDelta moves q/k/mlp matrices 0.5% back along their 2000→2400 displacement at step 2400; TrailDelta snapshots all non-embedding weights at 2650 and pulls back along the trailing 100-step displacement at 2750 (γ=−0.04) and 2850 (γ=−0.12, with β=1 momentum adding the previous Δ), so the 2400 and 2750 pulses edit live weights mid-training. At the final eval a normalized orthogonal 'phase' term (κ=0.01) is added on q/k/mlp, then all non-embedding weights move 8% toward the step-2400 anchor. The PowerCool horizon becomes 2950 but switches to 3010 at step 2600 (Muon LR jumps ×1.20), so training ends un-annealed (~3.9% of peak LR vs ~1.7% in #41) and the backward pulses/readouts provide the final smoothing.

changes.label: TrailDelta momentum pulses
changes.detail: Captures non-embedding params at 2650; at 2750 θ += −0.04·Δ and at 2850 θ += −0.12·(Δ + 1.0·Δ_prev), where Δ = θ − last reference (re-captured after each pulse); optimizer and EMA-Nesterov state are not touched.

changes.label: Final anchor readout (8% to step 2400)
changes.detail: Stores non-embedding params at step 2400 (after the BroadDelta pulse); right before the step-2850 validation applies θ += 0.08·(θ_2400 − θ).

changes.label: BroadDelta pulse on muon_other
changes.detail: q, k, mlp.fc, mlp.proj (attn.v/attn.proj excluded; 48 tensors) are captured at 2000 and at 2400 moved by −0.005·(θ − θ_2000), editing live weights mid-training.

changes.label: Orthogonal phase readout
changes.detail: Snapshots muon_other at 2650 (θ0) and 2750 (θ1); at the final eval v = θ − θ1, a = v − (θ1 − θ0), phase = a − proj_v(a) rescaled to ‖v‖ per tensor, θ += 0.01·phase (γ = 0), applied before the anchor readout.

changes.label: 2850 steps + tail LR horizon switch
changes.detail: train_steps 2900→2850; PowerCool t_end 2980→2950, switched to 3010 from step 2600 by _active_schedule_steps (LR ×1.20 at 2600; final Muon LR ≈1.5e-3 vs ≈6.5e-4).

changes.label: Step-keyed windows shift with 2850
changes.detail: EMA-Nesterov rest_steps = train_steps − 950 gives a lookahead window of 300–1900 (was 1950); the 100-step μ cooldown now spans 2750–2850.

changes.label: Env plumbing, checkpoints, eval control
changes.detail: Most constants become env-overridable; adds checkpoint save/load, macro-accumulation and CEM search (off), final-readout alpha grid (off) and dense-eval controls (the run evaluates only at step 2850).

edge.parent_check: consistent: the Muon/SOAP/Circuit-Muon code and all #41 constants are unchanged; the docstring describes the base as PR311 (#41) plus the author's own 2850-step TrailDelta/final-readout line (no accepted intermediate record).
edge.noise: Env-ification of constants, MODEL_DIM/HEAD_DIM/COMPILE env, checkpoint save/load + dataloader alignment, macro-accum/CEM search and alpha-grid paths (off by default and in the run), per-group pulse diagnostics in logs, and VAL_REGULAR_INTERVAL/DENSE_EVAL controls (eval-only).

techniques.note: 12 NS iters (a,b,c = 2,−1.5,0.5) on Schatten-4-normalized input; Nesterov-EMA μ; √max(1,m/n)
mlp.fc & mlp.proj: eigenbasis-Adam on momentum, basis refresh every 10 steps, β2 0.90
attn.v only (SOAP blend 0.95, denom floor 0.55); attn.proj trust-gate code dormant
−0.2 × unit-norm momentum added around the NS step, ramped linearly to 0 by step 2500
wide mlp.proj only: 3 D-rescaled NS passes (β=0.25) toward uniform per-hidden-unit leverage
unchanged from #41: 12 attn.v↔attn.proj pairs, partner post-whiten + gauge projection, λ=1e-3
outward radial part of the update ×0.5; post-step rescale to first-order target radius
update scaled up so ‖U‖F/‖W‖F ≥ 0.3825 on every Muon matrix; no weight decay
lookahead 0.3·lr/lr0 along EMA(0.99) of per-step displacement, steps 300–1900
t_end 2950, switched to 3010 at step 2600 (LR ×1.20); run ends at ~3.9% of peak Muon LR
μ 0.85→0.95 over first 300 steps; 0.95→0.85 over steps 2750–2850
every param named *proj* zeroed: attn.proj, mlp.proj, lm head (weights and biases)
norm1/norm2 gains = 1 ∓ 0.14·s, s Rademacher per channel, all 12 blocks
TrailDelta ref 2650, pulses 2750 (γ −0.04) & 2850 (γ −0.12, β=1); BroadDelta 2000→2400 γ −0.005
q/k/mlp matrices, t0 2650 / t1 2750; final θ += 0.01·normalized orthogonal phase term
at final eval θ += 0.08·(θ_2400 − θ) on all non-embedding params
fused AdamW (bias-corrected): embed 0.3, head 1/320, 1-D 0.01; β(0.8,0.99), eps 1e-10, wd 0

hparams.hidden.optimizer: Muon (SOAP on mlp.fc/mlp.proj/attn.v) + Contra + Aurora + Circuit-Muon

mechanisms.name: TrailDelta / BroadDelta pulses
mechanisms.explain: TrailDelta snapshots all non-embedding params at step 2650; whenever 100 steps have elapsed (2750, 2850) it forms Δ = θ − θ_ref (+ β·Δ_prev, β = 1.0), moves θ += γ·Δ with γ = −0.04 for the first pulse and −0.12 for the last, and re-snapshots θ_ref. BroadDelta is one pulse of the same form on muon_other matrices (q, k, mlp.fc, mlp.proj): θ += −0.005·(θ_2400 − θ_2000) at step 2400. The 2400 and 2750 pulses edit live weights mid-training without touching Muon/Adam/EMA-Nesterov state; the 2850 pulse lands just before the final eval.

mechanisms.name: Normalized orthogonal phase readout
mechanisms.explain: Snapshots muon_other params at t0 = 2650 and t1 = 2750 (t1 taken after the first TrailDelta pulse). At the final eval, per tensor: v = θ − θ_t1 and a = v − (θ_t1 − θ_t0); in orthogonal mode the phase term is a minus its projection onto v, rescaled to ‖v‖, and θ += 0·v + 0.01·phase — a small nudge along the direction in which the trajectory is turning. The logged move is ≈2e-4 of each tensor's norm.

mechanisms.name: Final anchor readout
mechanisms.explain: Captures all non-embedding params at step 2400 (after the BroadDelta pulse). Immediately before the step-2850 validation, after TrailDelta's final pulse and the phase readout, it applies θ += 0.08·(θ_2400 − θ), an 8% interpolation back toward the earlier anchor that is evaluated but never trained on.

caveats: The extracted script's in-code env defaults differ from the record run: by default BROAD_DELTA_GAMMA=0, PHASE_READOUT_KAPPA=0 and FINAL_READOUT_ALPHA=0 (all off), TrailDelta uses γ=−0.08/−0.08 with β=0, and the tail switch is 2650→3000. The record used run.sh overrides (switch 2600→3010; γ −0.04/−0.12, β 1.0; BroadDelta; phase κ 0.01; anchor α 0.08), confirmed by the logs' 'Using …' lines and pulse messages; this analysis reports that run configuration. SAVE_CHECKPOINT_STEPS=2000 and VAL_REGULAR_INTERVAL=0 in run.sh affect only I/O and evaluation. The anchor readout is the same interpolation form as sibling #42's fixed_ref_interp (θ += −0.075·(θ − θ_2375)), here with anchor 2400, α 0.08 and non-embedding scope; #42 is not in #43's ancestry.
